as_told.title: Armstrong overheard saying grays warned not to return

plain: Neil Armstrong is said to have told people in Washington in the 1970s, "We were told not to come back to the moon." Michels calls these "apocryphal stories" that he has heard. Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects some people say were implanted by aliens, says Armstrong was overheard saying it at a party. Colbern says the warning came from the "grays," the small grey beings of many alien accounts, which would mean someone else wanted the moon left alone.
